source_gap: FKP17 exact source 77052eb... terminal capability proof: identical action×register×delta counts and mean rewards can alias different current-register, predecessor-action and order-conditional consequences.
mechanism: Under public-only delayed reward, bind *learned* pairs of binary primitives into one four-entry two-bit truth table. Choose which two binary features and which truth table based solely on actually earned reward outcomes; no causal rule names/operators/source family IDs passed to learner.
feature_basis: 32 register bits across 8 uint4 public registers, three bits of previous public action, three bits of second-previous public action; 38 input binary features
allowed_output: Action 0 or 1 among the full [0..7] public action schema; non-0/1 credited events are explicitly rejected, no reinterpreting 8-action outcomes as binary
credit: reward observed at step t belongs to public action at t-2, using eligible.before and action history[-3]/[-4]. Before t>=3, reward 0 and no training. Reward +/-1 after; signed reward on the actually executed eligible action is the only supervision.
capacity: At most 128 delayed credited examples, six serialized bytes each (5-bitfield bytes and 1 target-action label). During fit <=768 logical bytes + derived counts. After seal the persistent learned relation is only two feature addresses, one four-bit truth table and sample/custody digest; checkpoint authenticated with SHA256.
candidate_selection: Evaluate all unordered pairs of distinct 38 features (703 pairs), each with the empirically majority-voted 4-bin truth table; require all four input combinations observed; select highest correct count, then lexicographic feature IDs. Fail closed when <90% fit accuracy.
control: Independent conventional exhaustive lookup over the same 703 feature-pairs, same 4-bin truth functions, identical public examples. Strong control tie is expected; do not claim unique advantage.
tests: Fixed public-only synthetic examples covering (a) two register bits XOR, (b) register bit with previous action bit XOR, (c) register bit with older action bit AND; 128 common training events and 128 new-context evaluation events per family; frozen Python local seeds 7125, 7126, 7127; deliberate invalid source/private fields; deterministic cold restore; cap overflow; no source import.

pre_frozen_gates.learned_binding_source_feature_recovery: >=2 of 3 synthetic families recover equivalent 128 new-context truth outcomes
pre_frozen_gates.cold_prediction_replay: exact byte-for-byte checkpoint and choices across restore
pre_frozen_gates.baselines: independent conventional exact-pair lookup must have >= same information and scored outcomes; report mean delta without omission
pre_frozen_gates.fkp17_alias_nonrepetition: verify at least one pair of public source-safe histories with equal marginal (action,register,delta) and action rewards but different bound context/temporal decision; do not execute original held science
pre_frozen_gates.memory: after-seal persisted learned model <=128 bytes; actual Python heap and whole-process cost separately reported, no unmeasured speed claims
pre_frozen_gates.stop: No post-outcome retune of pair/threshold/fixture/seed. If candidate ties control, architectural expressivity may pass but SCIENTIFIC_PASS false.

scope: Unqualified isolated native-style research candidate only, not accepted Yggdrasil native model, no new workflow, runner, scheduler or owner first use
